name: December Design Box
website_meta_description: Discover expert print design services for fashion, home, and accessories. Shop exclusive prints or commission custom artwork and technical sketches. Elevate your brand with bespoke designs—explore now!

pages.text: December Design Box About Print Shop GREENKIVE Services Let's Talk! December Design Box About Print Shop GREENKIVE Services Let's Talk! About December Design Box is a small print studio , built around a love for texture, color, and shape in the world around us, focused on bringing fresh character into fashion and lifestyle products . I’m Alka, the designer behind the studio, and if you'd like to discuss a project, your next collection, or a one-off piece, I’d love to chat and explore how we can bring your idea to life.
